# Visual polish regression scenes

These specifications came from Muse runs on original synthetic screenshots during the October 30 usability audit. IDs were rebound to neutral test identifiers. Browser tests replay them as prepared fixtures; they make no provider call.

The gradient scene deliberately retains the original semantic error: its +0.75 arrow ends at w=3 rather than w=2.25. It is an invalid teaching example retained to test reviewer rejection/repair and presentation. It must not be promoted to a prepared lesson or described as scientifically verified. The weighted scene is a separate source-specific graph used for layout regression checks. No private coursework, student records, screenshot bytes, session cookies or credentials are included.
